summary: Cresud Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the nine and three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report with no extraordinary corporate transaction, no offer, no tender, no restructuring, and no activist campaign disclosed. The document provides standard financial statements, segment information, and notes to accounts. There is no event triggering special-situation classification such as an acquisition, divestiture, going-private, or capital return. The filing is purely informational and does not indicate any material change or event that would categorize it under SEC special-situations categories.
